decisions_log.decision: Used plain inline SVG paths for Sun/Moon icons rather than lucide-react.
decisions_log.rationale: lucide-react is not in package.json. Adding a new dependency was not warranted for two simple icons; SVG paths keep the bundle minimal and introduce no install-time risk.

decisions_log.decision: ThemeToggle renders a same-size <div aria-hidden> placeholder on server and initial client paint, then mounts the real button after useEffect.
decisions_log.rationale: Server-rendered HTML always reflects theme='light' (no DOM access), so rendering the button server-side would produce the wrong icon and cause a hydration mismatch. The placeholder prevents layout shift while still matching the server's output.

decisions_log.decision: ThemeProvider syncs from document.documentElement.classList in useEffect rather than reading localStorage directly.
decisions_log.rationale: The blocking script is the single source of truth for the initial class; reading the DOM avoids duplicating the fallback logic and means the React state always matches what the user actually sees, even in edge cases where the script ran before hydration.

decisions_log.decision: Placed ThemeToggle inside a <header> element added to RootLayout rather than modifying Footer.tsx.
decisions_log.rationale: Footer.tsx is not in components_touched. A dedicated <header> is the idiomatic location for site-wide controls and provides better visual affordance (top-of-page) than a footer toggle.

files_changed.summary: React Context provider exposing theme ('light'|'dark') and toggleTheme. On mount syncs state with whatever .dark class the blocking script already applied to <html>. toggleTheme flips state, persists to localStorage, and toggles the .dark class.

Client-side icon button (Sun/Moon inline SVGs) that calls toggleTheme from useTheme. Defers icon rendering until after client mount to prevent hydration mismatches. Accessible via aria-label that reflects the current mode.

Added a minimal inline blocking <script> into <head> that reads localStorage then prefers-color-scheme and applies .dark to <html> before any paint (FOUC prevention). Wrapped body in ThemeProvider and added a persistent <header> containing ThemeToggle so the toggle is reachable from every page.

Added Tailwind v4 @custom-variant dark declaration to use the class strategy. Replaced @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block with a .dark CSS rule so dark: utilities and CSS variables activate from the programmatic class rather than the media query.

self_assessment.notes: All Must requirements met: visible toggle on every page, localStorage persistence, OS preference respected on first visit, blocking script prevents FOUC. Tailwind class strategy configured via @custom-variant dark in globals.css. No third-party theme library used. Blocking script is a single minified IIFE. 24/24 tests pass across Footer, ThemeProvider, and ThemeToggle suites.
